identity.name: The Japan Times
identity.description: Japan's oldest English-language daily newspaper, covering Japanese politics, business, society and international affairs.

ownership.ownershipNotes: Published by The Japan Times, Ltd., a subsidiary of News2u Holdings. Commercial ownership; historically associated with Japanese establishment and international-business readership.

editorialOrientation.evidence: Commercial newspaper with bylined reporting and a range of domestic views; no evidence of direct state editorial control.
editorialOrientation.source: Ownership and self-description via Official about page; secondary references; feed-level sample

politicalLeaning.evidence: Generally centrist, internationally minded Japanese coverage; MBFC page did not expose a clean parsed rating.
politicalLeaning.source: Analyst assessment from publisher self-description, secondary references and feed-level sample

economicPerspective.evidence: Business coverage is market-aware but not consistently ideological.
economicPerspective.source: Analyst assessment from business and economic coverage

internationalAlignment.evidence: Frames regional security through Japanese alliance and democratic-institution perspectives.
internationalAlignment.source: Ownership, editorial positioning and regional coverage sample

reliability.evidence: Established newspaper of record with editorial standards; MBFC page available but no clean rating parsed.
reliability.source: Analyst assessment from ownership, editorial record and feed-level sample

externalRatings.notes: MBFC page exists but no clean bias/factual fields were parsed. Assessed from institutional record.

intelligence.knownPerspective: Japanese English-language newspaper voice. Explains Japan through domestic politics, business and alliance management for an internationally oriented readership.

selectionRationale: Provides a Japanese national perspective in English that complements Nikkei's business focus and Kyodo's wire coverage.

research.researchNotes: Existing production mapping retained. Ownership verified through parent-company page and Wikipedia. Research is feed-level only; full article sampling and peer review remain outstanding.
